tests.title: ReadOnlyFileTools contains exactly the seven expected names in the correct order
tests.when: ReadOnlyFileTools is inspected
then: it contains exactly seven entries
the entries are, in order: read_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol, find_references

tests.title: find_references is in neither MutatingTools nor ShellTools, so AssertReadOnly passes
tests.when: MutatingTools and ShellTools are inspected and AssertReadOnly is called with a tool set that includes find_references
then: find_references is not in MutatingTools
find_references is not in ShellTools
AssertReadOnly returns nil for a resolved set containing all seven read tools
tests.pseudocode:
assert !slices.Contains(agentrun.MutatingTools, "find_references")
assert !slices.Contains(agentrun.ShellTools, "find_references")
resolved := []core.Tool{{Name: "read_file"}, {Name: "list_files"}, {Name: "find_files"}, {Name: "search_files"}, {Name: "file_outline"}, {Name: "find_symbol"}, {Name: "find_references"}}
assert agentrun.AssertReadOnly(resolved) == nil

tests.title: registeredTools calls tools.All once per phase invocation, giving each phase its own reference table
tests.when: two phases are run in sequence (e.g. analyse then implement in fix)
then: both phases' model requests include find_references
the tool sets are built from separate tools.All calls (verified by having separate request objects)
tests.pseudocode:
p := faux.New(toolCallTurn("c1", "submit_analysis", validAnalysis()), toolCallTurn("c2", "submit_implementation", validImplementation()))
b := &agentBrain{runner: newRunner(fauxConfig(p, ws))}
b.Analyze(ctx, analysisInput{...})
nAnalyse := len(p.Requests())
b.Implement(ctx, implementInput{...})
reqs := p.Requests()
declaredA := toolNames(reqs[0])
declaredI := toolNames(reqs[nAnalyse])
assert declaredA["find_references"]
assert declaredI["find_references"]

then: the returned string contains the guideline text as a bullet under Tool guidelines
tests.pseudocode:
guideline := "Use find_symbol for where a name is declared, find_references for who uses it."
note := toolsNote([]core.Tool{{Name: "find_references", PromptGuidelines: []string{guideline}}, {Name: "read_file"}})

the triage row lists all seven tools explicitly

content := readFile("docs/model-usage.md")

tests.title: docs/development.md baseline tables have a find_references column with dashes in every cell
tests.when: the navigation baseline section is parsed
then: every baseline table header row includes a find_references column after find_symbol and before code_search
every data row in every baseline table has a dash in the find_references column
tests.pseudocode:
content := readFile("docs/development.md")
for each table header in baseline section:
  cols := splitTableRow(header)
  idxFR := indexOf(cols, "find_references")
  idxFS := indexOf(cols, "find_symbol")
  idxCS := indexOf(cols, "code_search")

  assert idxCS == idxFR + 1
for each data row in baseline section:
  cells := splitTableRow(row)
  assert cells[idxFR] == "—"

tests.title: docs/development.md jq snippet extracts find_references between find_symbol and code_search
tests.when: the jq code block in the navigation baseline section is read
then: it contains (.tool_calls.find_references // 0)
the find_references extraction appears after find_symbol and before code_search
tests.pseudocode:
content := readFile("docs/development.md")
jqBlock := extractJqCodeBlock(content)
assert strings.Contains(jqBlock, ".tool_calls.find_references // 0")
idxFR := strings.Index(jqBlock, "find_references")
idxFS := strings.Index(jqBlock, "find_symbol")
idxCS := strings.Index(jqBlock, "code_search")
assert idxFS < idxFR && idxFR < idxCS

tests.title: WithCodeSearch with on=true returns a new slice of len(ReadOnlyFileTools)+1 ending with code_search, without mutating the original
tests.when: WithCodeSearch is called with on=true and ReadOnlyFileTools as the grant
then: the result has length 8 (seven read tools plus code_search)
the last element is code_search
ReadOnlyFileTools still has exactly seven entries
modifying the result does not affect ReadOnlyFileTools
tests.pseudocode:
before := len(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools)
got := agentrun.WithCodeSearch(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools, true)
assert len(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools) == before
assert len(got) == before + 1
assert got[len(got)-1] == "code_search"
got[0] = "mutated"
assert agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools[0] != "mutated"

tests.title: WithCodeSearch with on=false returns the input grant unchanged
tests.when: WithCodeSearch is called with on=false
then: the result has the same length as ReadOnlyFileTools
the result does not contain code_search
tests.pseudocode:
same := agentrun.WithCodeSearch(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools, false)
assert len(same) == len(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools)
assert !slices.Contains(same, "code_search")
